capabilities: Look up the pronunciation of a selected phrase in YouGlish
Play YouTube clips of real people saying the word in context
Trigger the lookup from a plugin icon in the toolbar
extras: Requires manual installation by extracting release files into the vault's plugins folder; README notes the bundled widget.js was modified to export variables. No screenshots or configuration details are given.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hear how a word or phrase is actually pronounced by real people in context while writing.

relations.evidence: This is plugin uses youglish widget

summary: Pronunciation lookup plugin that opens a YouGlish widget showing how a selected phrase is spoken in YouTube videos.
